Euphorbia Hypericifolia.

Large Spotted Spurge. N. O. Euphorbiaceæ. Tincture of whole plant.

Clinical.─Constipation. Headache.

Characteristics.─Dr. True took infusion and tincture of Eu. hyper. and obtained these symptoms from both: Headache in fore part of head, pain centering at crown, with heat above the eyes and fulness and oppression at epigastrium; followed by languor and drowsiness. Constipation.
